resume: When it can be required (canteen, after-school care), what it covers, how to check your child is not already insured, and how to arrange it between separated parents.
aQuoiCaSert: School insurance (assurance scolaire) protects your child during school activities and on the way between home and school. It combines two types of cover: civil liability (responsabilité civile), for damage the child causes to others, and personal accident insurance (individuelle accident), for injuries the child suffers, even if they hurt themselves on their own. An extracurricular (extrascolaire) option also covers leisure activities and holidays, 24 hours a day, all year round.
quiEstConcerne: Parents of children in school, from nursery school to high school.
Parents whose child eats at the canteen or attends the town's after-school care, where a certificate may be required.
aSavoir: In principle, school insurance is optional, both for activities on the timetable (swimming pool, gym) and for optional outings (museum, trip).
However, it may be required for the canteen and for after-school activities organized by the town.
Civil liability is often already included in your home insurance, and some policies cover personal injury: check before you take out a policy.
Possible options depending on the policy: theft or extortion (racket), help to keep up with schoolwork at home in case of illness.
If your child changes school, let your insurer know.
Indicative cost according to service-public.gouv.fr: from about €10 per year per child.

etapes.detail: Home insurance, garantie des accidents de la vie (life accident cover), personal accident: ask your insurer whether your child is covered for school and after-school activities.

etapes.titre: Separated parents: decide who insures the child
etapes.detail: There is no point paying twice for the same cover. One policy is enough if the child is properly named on it; share the certificate.

etapes.titre: Take out a policy if needed
etapes.detail: With the insurer of your choice, or through a group policy offered by a parents' association or a private school.

etapes.titre: Check before handing in the file
etapes.detail: Certificate in the child's name, for the current school year, mentioning civil liability and, if requested, personal accident cover.
To the school, the town hall (canteen, after-school care) or the leisure center if it is requested.

actions.titre: Renew the school insurance certificate before school starts

aConfirmer: To be confirmed locally: the certificates required by your school, your town (canteen, after-school care) or the private school.
Check that the certificate's period of validity covers the school start date set by the académie de La Réunion (local education authority), which may differ from the mainland France calendar.
